name: thumbnail-carousel
title: Thumbnail Carousel
description: A swipeable slide with a thumbnail strip underneath. The active thumbnail widens and the strip glides to centre it.

props.name: items
props.description: The slides: { id, title, media, thumb? }.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Index of the slide shown first.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the new index when the slide changes.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the main slide in pixels.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns dragging and the buttons off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
